notes.title: Playtest Update 2!
notes.content:
A big update just dropped for the playtest, bringing tons of improvements to check out!

🧱 Here’s what’s new:

- New obstacles to spice up the course 

- 8 maps with a more polished and finalized look

- 4 brand-new levels set in a mountain environment ❄️

- And of course… slippery ice surfaces designed to drive you crazy (and make you laugh just as much as we did)

We hope the chaos brings as many laughs (and frustrated yells) as it did during our internal tests!

Thanks again for all your feedback—it’s been super valuable in helping us improve the game 🙌
